final:
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  post out.len() <= keys.len() + 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["mode"], ["slow"]) == ["slow", "3"]
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  ex settings(["x", "level"], ["y", "5"]) == ["fast", "5", "y"]
  ex settings(["x", "mode", "z"], ["1", "slow", "2"]) == ["slow", "3", "1", "2"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var ek: List[str] = []
  var ev: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    let v = values[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode = copy v
    else if k == "level"
      level = copy v
    else
      var found = -1
      for j in range(0, ek.len())
        if ek[j] == k
          found = j
      if found >= 0
        ev[found] = copy v
      else
        ek.append(copy k)
        ev.append(copy v)
  var out: List[str] = []
  out.append(mode)
  out.append(level)
  for v in ev
    out.append(copy v)
  out

test_settings() =
  assert settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  assert settings(["x", "mode", "z", "x"], ["1", "slow", "2", "9"]) == ["slow", "3", "9", "2"]
